api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('trades')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', adversarial_logits, beta) -> torch.Tensor
description: Natural-label cross-entropy plus beta-weighted cross-entropy from the adversarial softmax distribution to the clean logits, following Zhang et al. §4 Eq. (5) and §5.2. The supplied adversarial prediction is used as-is; projected-gradient search stays outside this loss. Structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Train a paired-view classifier with TRADES

name: TRADES robustness-accuracy loss

parameters.additional parameters: adversarial_logits and beta are the only accepted keys in **params; both are required
parameters.adversarial_logits: floating-point adversarial class logits shaped [B, C], matching the clean logits in shape, dtype, and device
parameters.beta: finite positive real trade-off coefficient beta=1/lambda; required because the paper specifies no software default
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer target index to exclude from both loss terms (default None)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point clean class logits shaped [B, C] with B > 0 and C >= 2
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example losses, mean averages valid examples, or sum totals valid examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: class indices shaped [B], provided as integer or integral-valued floating-point tensors; ignored labels are excluded when ignore_index is set
